Release notes/v0.13.10/Nov 27, 2026

What's new in Cadence 0.13.10.

> The Windows installer is still building and will be added here shortly.

By Cadence Labs · Filed in Releases

§01 Fixed

  • Opening a Drive file from your iPhone stalled your Mac's replies. Showing a file's history ran a blocking network call on the thread that answers your phone, so the phone sat on "Getting it from your Mac…" and other replies waited behind it. Drive's work now runs beside that thread.
  • Big files came slowly. Each piece of a file went to the phone as base64 inside JSON and was base64'd again for the relay, 2.4× its size on the wire, one piece at a time. Pieces now travel as raw bytes (1.8×), the Mac reads only the piece asked for, and the phone asks for four at once.
